messages.subject: Hacked email
parts:
Dear all=2C



I am shocked this morning to find that someone hacked into my email and=20
sent out messages to all my contact list. I am receiving replies from=20
people concerning a message i have no idea about. It seems to be a=20
website being circulated around that is NOT worth visiting!! Please=20
ignore any message with a website you may have no idea about!



For that matter=2C i will for sometime be using my Makerere University emai=
l which is more secured doch...@muienr.mak.ac.ug



Apologies for any inconveniences caused.



Thank you.



David Ochanda. =
